answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 136 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the echo challenge, the relic audit can replay the basalt history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4020 identities would post 2351 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
